objective: Ensure factory reset on controller node clears identity, MQTT credentials, and runtime state from NVS flash storage.

acceptance.criterion: Factory reset arm in EventDispatcher removes device_id, mqtt_user, mqtt_pass, runtime_snap, crop_recipe, and recipe_rev NVS keys alongside active_recipe, safety_budget, and wifi list.
acceptance.verification: Code inspection and compilation verification in ESP32-C3-CONTROLLER-NODE
